summary: Columbus Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands blank-check company listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K reporting that its Extraordinary General Meeting was convened and then adjourned without any shareholder vote on September 28, 2026. The meeting, originally scheduled for September 10, 2026, has been pushed to September 29, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. ET to consider the proposed business combination with WISeSat.Space Corp. The record date remains August 17, 2026. All proposals from the August 19, 2026 definitive proxy statement remain pending. Watch for potential redemptions, vote outcome, and any further adjournments as arbitrage risk.
